cmd.flag.locale: reply and message locale (default $EMPLOYEE_LOCALE, else en)
cmd.flag.token: bearer token shared by the HTTP boundaries (default $EEL_TOKEN)
cmd.flag.loop: base URL of the Employee Loop event ingress
cmd.employee_loop.flag.persona: file with the employee's persona instructions (default: a generic colleague)
cmd.employee_loop.flag.serve: serve the HTTP event ingress on this address, for example :8081
cmd.employee_loop.flag.tasks: base URL of a remote Task Manager (default: in-process task manager with the echo executor)
cmd.employee_loop.flag.deliver: base URL of a remote deliverer (default: print deliveries to stdout)
cmd.employee_loop.flag.stdin: read stdin lines as messages to the employee in a local scene
cmd.employee_loop.flag.speaker: display name of the person typing on stdin
cmd.employee_loop.started: employee loop {employee} started: locale {locale}, tasks {tasks}, deliveries {deliver}, ingress {serve}
cmd.employee_loop.stdin_hint: Type a message for the employee; /quit ends.
cmd.employee_loop.model_config: model configuration ({error}); set LLM_API_KEY, LLM_PROVIDER and LLM_MODEL
cmd.task_manager.flag.serve: serve the Task Manager API on this address
cmd.task_manager.flag.delay: how long the echo executor works on each run
cmd.task_manager.started: task manager listening on {addr}, reporting to {loop}
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.cid: conversation to listen to: openConversationId (group) or openDingTalkId (dm)
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.profile: dws --profile (corpId:userId); empty uses the current profile
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.self_id: the employee's own openDingTalkIds, comma separated
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.self_name: the employee's own display names, comma separated
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.serve: serve the delivery API on this address
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.namespace: namespace that scene ids are minted in
cmd.dws_gateway.started: dws gateway listening to {conversation} ({kind}), publishing to {loop}, deliveries on {addr}
cmd.dws_gateway.flag.reactions: JSON file with the reaction policy (negative_names, negative_substrings); default: the embedded gateway/dws/reactions.json
cmd.task_manager.flag.loops: per-employee loop ingress, employee=URL,... (events of other employees go to -loop)
